fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16.name: 日之呼吸・灼骨炎陽（R16 #79・新版漩渦）
fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16._doc: 灼骨炎陽新版特效（R16b）：突刺瞬間在前方爆出 7 道彼此分離的明亮火焰，各自沿不同半徑、轉速、長度、彎曲度的螺旋軌跡繞同一軸旋轉、往前推進（減速，不是一直延伸的火管）、往外散開，各自在不同時間撕裂熄滅；白金核心＋金橘主體，尖端少量淡粉紅；命中爆燃只在實際命中。沒有腳邊收縮火圈、沒有中心火柱、沒有大圓環。動作不變。R16c：主火焰改成 3 道寬 1.35 m、較厚的火焰帶＋同一路徑的橘紅外焰層＋2 道內側小捲＋第二刀 3 道往兩側甩；彼此保留空隙；沒有命中爆炎。

mesh._doc: 沒有 GLB：刀身熱邊（蓄勢逐漸點燃）。

fx2/sun_retsujitsu.name: 日之呼吸・烈日紅鏡（新版特效）

mesh._doc: 沒有 GLB：刀身熱邊。

fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16d.name: 灼骨炎陽（影像參考重製・厚焰捲輪）
fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16d._doc: R16e VFX only: game j6xulWS7zdw 83-97 s (main fire 93-95.5), anime FeXwZmmmYFM 41-48 s. Sculpted broad outer scroll and inward fold share an open centre around the body, with real axial depth. Quick full-size ignition, short rotation, torn long remnants. Not three isolated arcs. Animation/shot/root unchanged.

fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16f.name: 灼骨炎陽（日輪渦・影像參考重製）
fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16f._doc: R16g VFX only (R16f animation/timing/damage untouched): star -> white sun disk with a burning rim -> opens into one ribbon winding inward ~1.9 turns with dark gaps, the swordsman in its eye, turning with the blade wheel -> climax flare -> tears into hooked scrolls that drift apart and erode. Cel palette yellow/orange/vermilion/deep red + partial dark contour. Replaces the wreath in the dojo default only; the wreath stays as profile sun_shakkotsu_r16f (B key) and fx2/sun_shakkotsu_r16d.
